deployments_detail.use: Chat Concierge: a proprietary multi-agentic conversational AI assistant embedded on car-dealership websites (and Capital One's Navigator platform) that helps buyers compare vehicles, explore inventory, answer personalized questions and schedule test drives, with NLU, action planning, a hallucination/validation layer and policy simulation. Built on Meta's open-source Llama, customized with proprietary data. [Meta Llama (base model), Capital One proprietary multi-agent framework]
"Chat Concierge" proprietary multi-agentic conversational AI for auto-buying (on dealer sites) + Eno assistant

Generative AI agent-servicing / knowledge-retrieval tool: a RAG-based assistant giving customer-service agents real-time semantic/hybrid search over Capital One data to resolve customer questions faster, reducing hold times. Deployed to roughly 20,000 agents across business units. [AWS SageMaker (LLM inference), AWS OpenSearch (retrieval), NVIDIA A100 GPUs]
deployments_detail.value: ~20,000 agents; top-5 search success rose from 84% to 93%

deployments_detail.use: Eno virtual assistant: an ML-powered natural-language chatbot (the first natural-language SMS chatbot from a US bank) that answers account questions, delivers spending insights, sends real-time suspicious-activity/fraud alerts and generates virtual card numbers for online purchases. [Capital One proprietary (machine learning / NLP)]

Proprietary multi-agentic AI framework (MACAW) that assists several hundred bank customer-service agents who specialize in complex fraud cases, breaking down complex requests into tasks handled by specialized agents. [Capital One proprietary multi-agent framework; NVIDIA AI ecosystem]
Machine-learning speech recognition in call-center operations powering an automated agent training and validation (quality assurance) system. [AWS]

Real-time machine-learning fraud detection and prevention on card transactions, including interactive customer alerts, automated card lock/replacement and temporary card access, with a focus on dynamically reducing false positives. [TensorFlow on AWS]

VulnHunter: an open-sourced agentic AI code-security tool that applies attacker-perspective 'forward analysis' to source code to identify potentially exploitable vulnerabilities, trace attack paths and propose targeted code repairs, with a self-disproving/falsification step to minimize speculative alerts. [Capital One proprietary (open-sourced agentic AI)]

Capital One Databolt: a tokenization/data-protection product that replaces sensitive data with format-preserving de-identified tokens so teams can safely use data for AI, analytics and customer intelligence; natively integrated with AWS (Redshift, Aurora, RDS) via UDFs/APIs/SDKs. [Capital One Software; AWS (Redshift, Aurora, RDS)]

Generative AI coding tools deployed to Capital One software developers to accelerate the coding experience and improve engineering efficiency (code generation/assist), governed by internal evaluation systems and release controls for approved AI models and coding agents. [none]

Transformer-based real-time personalization system that customizes the digital and mobile customer experience across channels for more than 100 million customers, enabling rapid experimentation and proactive communications. [Capital One proprietary (transformer-based AI)]
